description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Amendment to the Direction No. 58 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1918/17 of 11.06.2015
reasoning: This gazette content is a correction notice for a Direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It pertains to a legal/regulatory matter concerning the amendment of a statutory instrument's effective date, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for subsidiary legislation and regulatory corrections.
